strategies.name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
strategies.description: Systematically tense and relax muscle groups
steps: Start with your toes, tense for 5 seconds
Release and feel the relaxation for 10 seconds
Move up through your body: feet, calves, thighs, etc.
End with your face and head

strategies.name: 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding
strategies.description: Use your senses to ground yourself in the present

strategies.name: Safe Place Visualization
steps: Close your eyes and take deep breaths
Imagine a place where you feel completely safe
Notice the colors, sounds, and smells
Feel the peace and safety of this place
Stay here for a few moments

strategies.name: Mindfulness Break
strategies.description: Take a mindful pause during your day
steps: Return to your activity with renewed focus

strategies.name: Cognitive Restructuring
steps: Ask: Is there evidence for and against it?
Ask: Would I tell a friend this?

strategies.name: Physical Release
steps: Stand up and shake your arms and legs
Do shoulder rolls forward and backward
